card.name: Prepositions in descent and history
card.fires_on: Small linking words like from, by, over or of after verbs of descent, origin or long time spans, in history, ancestry and religion text. Also digits inside year counts like 27 years or 15,000 years.

modes.label: Descent and origin
modes.description: A preposition after a word of descent or founding, before an ancestor or founder.
modes.example: who is descended<< from>> Amaterasu, the sun-godd

modes.label: Over the centuries
modes.description: The word over after a verb, before a span of years or centuries.
modes.example: has spread all across the world<< over>> the centuries, and as the name Czech

modes.label: Digits in year counts
modes.description: Digits in a number of years that is about to be followed by the word years.
modes.example: around 15,<<0>>00 years ago, with a group

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like modern and centuries and away from advanced.
card.plain: It fires on little words in history and ancestry text, where a span of past time or an origin is about to be named.
